extDescription.message: A Chrome extension that spots likely AI-made shortform content and filters it locally.

popupTagline.message: Filters out shortform posts that look like AI slop.

popupEnabledHelp.message: When this is on, SlopSkip watches supported pages and filters posts automatically.

popupReelsAutoExpandCaptionHelp.message: Automatically opens the caption on every reel so AI slop can be detected more accurately. If you turn this off, SlopSkip will not tap reel captions at all.

popupDebugModeHelp.message: Shows extra score details and clues behind each decision. You can leave this off most of the time.

popupPauseOnManualRevisitHelp.message: If you scroll back up or use an up key to revisit a post, SlopSkip will stop auto-filtering that post.

popupSensitivityHelp.message: Controls how easily a post gets filtered. Higher means stricter.

popupSensitivityConservativeHelp.message: Only filters when the signal looks pretty clear.

popupSensitivityBalancedHelp.message: A safer default that catches a lot without being too jumpy.

popupSensitivityAggressiveHelp.message: Filters quickly when content looks suspicious. May catch more false positives.

popupMarkSlopHelp.message: Adds a strong local block so this creator gets filtered more aggressively.

popupMarkAllowHelp.message: Protects this creator from being filtered unless there is a very strong signal.

popupClearVoteHelp.message: Removes the local allow or block choice you saved for this creator.

popupOpenOptionsHelp.message: Open the full settings page for thresholds, keywords, and local data.

popupStatusUnsupported.message: This page is not supported yet.

optionsSubtitle.message: Adjust filter strength, add your own keywords, and inspect what is stored locally.

optionsThresholdTitleHelp.message: Lower numbers filter more easily. Higher numbers make filtering more cautious.

optionsRulesTitleHelp.message: Add phrases you want SlopSkip to remember locally. One line per phrase.

optionsRulesBody.message: Enter one keyword or phrase per line. These stay in your browser only.

optionsRulesEnHelp.message: Phrases you often see in English captions or comments.

optionsRulesKoHelp.message: Phrases you often see in Korean captions or comments.

optionsRulesDefaultHelp.message: Phrases you want checked regardless of language.

optionsExportTitleHelp.message: Lets you inspect the settings and local decisions currently stored in your browser.

optionsExportButtonHelp.message: Displays the current SlopSkip data as JSON.

toastWouldSkip.message: Preview: this would be filtered because of $1. (score $2)

toastSkipTransitionUnconfirmed.message: A skip was requested, but the next post transition was not confirmed.

toastManualRevisitCountdown.message: You brought this slop back up. Skipping again in $1...
